# Lingostar

> Lingostar is an AI-powered language learning platform for practicing real
> conversations in English, Spanish, and French. Users speak or type with an
> AI conversation partner and get instant feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and
> pronunciation. Lingostar also publishes free Spanish grammar reference
> content, including full verb conjugation charts.

## Practice

- [AI Conversation Practice](https://lingostar.ai/practice): Practice speaking
  naturally with an AI conversation partner on topics like travel, business,
  or everyday scenarios; get real-time grammar and pronunciation feedback.

## Spanish Grammar Reference

- [Spanish Verb Conjugation Charts](https://lingostar.ai/spanish/conjugation/):
  Index of full conjugation tables for the most common Spanish verbs — every
  tense and mood (indicative, subjunctive, imperative), with irregular forms
  flagged and explained. Each verb has its own page at
  `/spanish/conjugation/{verb}`, e.g. `/spanish/conjugation/tener`,
  `/spanish/conjugation/ser`, `/spanish/conjugation/hablar`.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://lingostar.ai/blog/): Articles about language learning.
